title: School Tickets
intro:
PYT offers discounted tickets for school group bookings to student matinee performances of Center Stage Musicals, and to Friday performances of Stories on Stage productions. Contact the MVCPA box office directly for all student tickets, using the links below.

Center Stage Musicals, Student Matinee performances: $10 per ticket (groups of 10+)

Stories on Stage, Student Matinee performances: $7 dollars per ticket (groups 10+)

listings.title: Creepy Carrots!
listings.description: Jasper Rabbit loves carrots, especially the ones from Crackenhopper Field. He eats them everywhere he goes. Until the day they start following him... or do they? Based on the beloved book by Aaron Reynolds and illustrated by Peter Brown, this funny and slightly spooky tale is the perfect fall treat for our youngest community members and their families.

listings.title: The Wizard of Oz
listings.description: Follow the yellow brick road to join Dorothy’s adventures with her friends as they brave the Wizard in the Emerald City. This inspiration for Wicked contains the songs from the beloved MGM musical starring Judy Garland, and is a treat the whole family can enjoy.

listings.title: The Night Before Christmas
listings.description: We are thrilled to present the world premiere of this brand-new Stories on Stage production! Find out what REALLY happened on that famous night before Christmas, told by someone who was actually there, and wants it known for the record that she absolutely was stirring!

listings.title: A Connecticut Yankee In King Arthur's Court
listings.description: A modern kid on a castle tour gets accidentally transported to the court of King Arthur, and her cell phone definitely does not have service. Based on Mark Twain’s classic, this fun retelling is full of laughs as our hero navigates courtly manners and medieval sensibilities to find her way back home.

listings.title: Rumpelstiltskin's Daughter
listings.description: In this merry rethinking of the classic fairy tale, Rumpelstiltskin and the miller's daughter are wed, and sixteen years later, their daughter faces the same golden dilemma. But this fairy-tale heroine has canny plans of her own. Based on the book by Diane Stanley, Rumpelstiltskin’s Daughter is a story about a girl who finds her own role to play, on her own terms.

listings.title: Singin' In The Rain
listings.description: Based on the “Greatest Movie Musical of All Time,” this Hollywood classic is packed with hilarious situations, snappy dialogue, and a hit-parade score that will have the whole house tapping their toes and grinning from ear to ear. This delightful classic is a guaranteed good time for performers and audience members alike.

listings.title: Lilly's Purple Plastic Purse
listings.description: Lilly loves everything! School, dressing up, and even her stinky baby brother, Julius. But when she cannot wait until sharing time to show off her purple plastic purse and movie star sunglasses, things do not go quite as planned. A charming, funny, and heartfelt story based on the book by Kevin Henkes, perfect for the littlest members of our community.

listings.title: Alice in Wonderland
listings.description: Follow Alice down the rabbit hole and join her on her adventures with the Caterpillar, the Mad Hatter, and the Queen of Hearts! This classic tale has been specially adapted for Stories on Stage, a fitting and magical close to another season of stories shared together.
